title: Encyclopedia of the Diaspora
summary: A publication named in the book’s front matter.

enrichment.markdown:
- **Encyclopedia of the Diaspora** (*Encyclopedia of Diaspora*, אנציקלופדיה של גלויות) was a Jerusalem-based publishing project that issued community memorial volumes. Yad Vashem records an edition titled *Warsaw*, volume 1, published in 1953. ([Yad Vashem](https://store.yadvashem.org/he/%D7%A1%D7%A4%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%99%D7%93%D7%A9%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%9E%D7%A1%D7%A4%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%99%D7%AA-%D7%99%D7%93-%D7%95%D7%A9%D7%9D-6))

- The series was cited by Yad Vashem scholarship as a source for volumes on **Grodno**, **Lviv**, and Warsaw-related Holocaust history, indicating broad geographic coverage beyond Sokółka. ([Yad Vashem](https://wwv.yadvashem.org/odot_pdf/Microsoft%20Word%20-%206111.pdf), [Yad Vashem](https://wwv.yadvashem.org/odot_pdf/Microsoft%20Word%20-%206105.pdf))

- JewishGen’s digitized catalog identifies the publisher as **Hevra “Encyclopedia of the Diaspora,” Jerusalem**, including the *Zolkiew* memorial book. ([JewishGen](https://www.jewishgen.org/yizkor/Zhovkva1/files/Zolkiew.pdf))

- I found no allow-listed archive record specifically identifying a **Sokółka** volume or catalog entry under this title. Searches covered Yad Vashem, JewishGen, YIVO Encyclopedia, and Wikipedia, including Hebrew, Polish, and English variants.
